Unit tests for fd_clock calibration, API, and epoch refresh.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test program for the `fd_clock` API. It checks compile-time layout and status code values with `FD_STATIC_ASSERT`, then tests clock creation, join, leave, delete, error handling, and string conversion functions. The program also runs a timed measurement loop to verify `fd_clock_now`, `fd_clock_recal`, `fd_clock_epoch_y`, and related functions, while collecting statistics on timing cost and synchronization error. It finishes by refreshing the clock epoch, cleaning up allocated state, and reporting `pass` when all tests succeed.
